decision_rule: Keep the existing S1/S2 predictions, material Pair/Set selections and all original tickets immutable.

An Exact candidate must contain three distinct known-context runners, the original W front Head, original Head-local P2 front and original Pair-conditioned Third front, with all actual historical paths retained.
Across the five existing KRS scenarios, Head SSR-W weakly exceeds each other member of this three-horse set in every scenario and strictly exceeds each rival in at least one scenario.

Across the same scenarios, Second SSR-P2 weakly exceeds Third SSR-P2 everywhere and is strictly greater in at least one scenario. Head W, Second P2 and Third P3 occurrences must each be positive in every scenario.
A disclosed historical World projection must admit at least one path combination with at most one exclusive LEAD_HOLD demand. Failure is a research Scenario conflict, never structural inability.

Compare all six orientations of each set, retaining every rejected/unresolved reason. The same-set unique robust Head/Second partial order permits at most one Exact orientation. Ties or crossing scenarios remain PROTECT_ONLY.

Only a tuple passing all checks is an EXACT_PURCHASE hypothesis in a separate PAPER request to unchanged Common MEC. This is a NEW Selection hypothesis, never an inferred existing Production decision.
